messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync: AcmeCorp dedicated bring-up is Friday 2026-06-04 09:00 PT. Please confirm autoscale params, priming lead, and the canary sequence. Target steady QPS=1.1k, peak=2.9k, KV warmup ~20-30m.
Samir Patel: Contract shows 1100 steady, 2900 peak. I'll attach the signed SOW to the runbook.
Jordan Lee: Autoscale proposal: min=2, max=20, cpu_target=60, cooldown=240s. We'll do staging dry-run tonight.
Maya Chen: @Jordan paste the autoscaler block for the runbook.
Jordan Lee: Block:
```
autoscale:
  min: 2
  max: 20
  cpu_target_pct: 60
  scale_up: 80
  scale_down: 40
  cooldown_s: 240
```
Eli Torres: I'll run priming 30m before canary using `./prime_kv.sh --pool acme --minutes 30 --parallel 10`. Note: quantized variant might need `acme-qv1` fallback.
Nina Gomez: Customer wants a 30-minute canary at 20% traffic before full ramp. I'll staff two CEs for that window.
Maya Chen: Plan: 08:30 PT canary start (20%), 09:00 PT full ramp. Ops-bot: please reserve pool and schedule priming.
ops-bot: reserved `acme-dedicated-v2` at 2026-06-04T07:00Z. Priming scheduled at 07:30Z. Canary 15:30Z (08:30 PT).
Samir Patel: Uploading `acme_bringup_0604.yaml` load profile.
Jordan Lee: We will monitor 95p latency and 5m error window. Rollback if error >0.5% for 3m.
Maya Chen: Preflight 06:00 PT. I'm good with the plan unless someone objects.
Samir Patel: All good from contract side.
Eli Torres: I'll post priming logs after run.
Maya Chen: Thanks team.
